summary: Docs lane of merge-if-eligible accepts docs/* head branches, so agents arm RFC and docs PRs without an operator step

options.description: docs source kind accepts ai-sdlc/file-* and docs/* heads under the same gates
keep ai-sdlc/file-* only; operator arms RFC and docs PRs by hand

body: Operator ruling 2026-10-21 17:20Z (AskUserQuestion, option chosen). PR #1780 (RFC walkthrough on docs/rfc-0056-oq-walkthrough) could not be armed by dispatch: the docs source kind accepts only ai-sdlc/file-* heads and the backlog kind needs a task id in the branch. Every RFC and docs PR in this repo lands from a docs/* branch, so each one needed an operator hand-arm. Operator principle: humans inside process loops are a source of error (mistyped commands, non-deterministic follow-through); humans are valuable for quality decisions, not for steps in the landing loop. Controls kept: author allow-list, green ai-sdlc/pr-ready, mergeStateStatus CLEAN; attestation gate still classifies by changed files. Implemented by AISDLC-1006 (PR #1829).
